capture: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
reference_frame: Synthetic calibration T-pose at frame 0; exclude from measured motion
scope: Native character authoring and engineering review. This receipt does not change any existing benchmark asset scope.
rights: CMU permits research and commercial use; the converter adds no restrictions. Keep READMEFIRST.txt outside Git alongside the downloaded source.
acknowledgment: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
limits: No captured finger/thumb motion or ground forces
Converted calibration frame is an empirical approximation
Foot support is estimated from recorded height and world speed
Phase alignment, target limb calibration, loop seam correction and terrain IK change the final pose
Only forward walking receives this capture; directional movement and running retain existing UE clips
